summary: Deleting a dataset that other objects still read now lists the whole downstream chain and offers deleting all of it together, instead of only refusing.
details: The refusal window lists every downstream object with its method type; clicking one still opens it so the input can be cleared instead.
A new Delete all button resubmits the delete with the whole chain included, after the list has shown exactly what it covers.
A delete is refused while a dependent update is running on the same reserving class, the same way a save is, so the two can never race.
